text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Trainer! Guess what!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I heard a store that makes personalized wrestling masks opened near the station!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yep! They can do animal masks, scary masks, cute masks… all kinds!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I already have the mask my papa gave me, so I don't really need one, but…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I've been thinkin' about this for a while now, and I think you need one too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So let's go get you one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I know it, I've been dragged off to the station.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So what kind of mask do you want, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Since you're my partner, you should probably have a condor mask, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Or, actually, maybe since I'm the ruler of the skies, you should be the ruler of the land?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ughhh, I can't decide!
choice_data_list: What about an elephant, for strength?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A cheetah! That's an opponent I gotta compete with some day! Safely, of course!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's great! A perfect match for the world's strongest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now, this mask is a present from me! Make sure to wear it at my races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A bit later…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh! You look so coooool! Just lookin' at you makes me wanna run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An excited El Condor Pasa looks quite satisfied with the finished cheetah mask.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I accept the gift gratefully, but politely refuse to wear it in the stands.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: An elephant! Massive! Powerful! The absolute strongest! Even stronger than me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, it's perfect for you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You have to be strong if you're going to support me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now, this mask is a present from me! Make sure to wear it at my races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A bit later…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! You look so strong! Overflowing with power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An excited El Condor Pasa looks quite satisfied with the finished elephant mask.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I accept the gift gratefully, but politely refuse to wear it in the stands.
